review: 612.2a-1: expected named the tokens 'Goblin', but under 111.4 an unnamed token is named after its subtypes plus 'Token'; changed to 'Goblin Token' (and 'Soldier Token' in the absent_type variant).
612.4-1: expected did not state the token's name; added that token 1 keeps the name Soldier Token, since under 111.4 a change to an existing token's subtype does not change its name.
612.7-1: the Equipment attachment lived only in notes; recorded it as attached_to in the setup.
612.8-1: target_renamed omitted that Honest Work, left unattached when Bears 1 returns to hand, goes to A's graveyard under 704.5m; added it.

scenarios.title: A text-changing effect changes a color word used as a color word but not the same word inside a card name

setup.notes: White Knight has the name word 'White' and the rules-text color word 'black' (protection from black).

decisions: A casts Sleight of Mind targeting White Knight, tapping Island, and chooses to replace the color word black with red.
Both players pass; Sleight of Mind resolves.
The board is read in main1 after resolution.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: White Knight is named White Knight and has first strike and protection from red; it no longer has protection from black.

variants.label: name_word
variants.delta: The chosen color word to replace is white instead of black, replaced with red.
variants.expected: White Knight is still named White Knight, with first strike and protection from black; nothing about it changed.

scenarios.forge_notes: Sleight of Mind has Duration$ Permanent. Its color choice goes through the activating player's chooseColor, so the scenario fixes both colors.

scenarios.title: A text-changing effect on a token-creating spell changes the created token's creature type and name

setup.notes: Raise the Alarm's text is 'Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.'

decisions: A casts Raise the Alarm, tapping both Plains.
B responds by casting Artificial Evolution targeting Raise the Alarm on the stack, tapping Island, and chooses to replace the creature type Soldier with Goblin.
Both players pass; Artificial Evolution resolves, then both pass again and Raise the Alarm resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Raise the Alarm resolves and creates two 1/1 white Goblin creature tokens named Goblin Token under A's control; there are no Soldier tokens.

variants.label: absent_type
variants.delta: B chooses to replace the creature type Elf with Goblin instead of Soldier with Goblin.
variants.expected: Raise the Alarm resolves and creates two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens named Soldier Token under A's control; there are no Goblin tokens.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge applies the text change to the token prototype in TokenInfo.protoTypeApplyTextChange; confirm the token's name follows its subtype.

scenarios.title: A text-changing effect does not alter an ability granted by another effect

setup.notes: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident has islandwalk only because Lord of Atlantis grants it; Bull Hippo has islandwalk printed on it.

decisions: A casts Mind Bend targeting Merfolk of the Pearl Trident, tapping Island, choosing to change a basic land type, replacing Island with Swamp.
Both players pass; Mind Bend resolves.
The board is read in main1 after resolution.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident is 2/2 and still has islandwalk (granted by Lord of Atlantis); it does not have swampwalk.

variants.label: printed
variants.delta: Mind Bend targets Bull Hippo instead of Merfolk of the Pearl Trident.
variants.expected: Bull Hippo is 3/3 and has swampwalk; it no longer has islandwalk.

scenarios.forge_notes: Mind Bend is a GenericChoice with a ChangeText sub-ability, so the scenario fixes the branch (land type) and both land types. Check that Forge leaves the AddKeyword$ Landwalk:Island granted by the static ability untouched.

scenarios.title: A text-changing effect on a token changes the token's subtypes

setup.notes: The two Soldier tokens are created during the decisions; they are called token 1 and token 2.

decisions: A casts Raise the Alarm, tapping both Plains.
Both players pass; Raise the Alarm resolves and creates two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens, token 1 and token 2.
A passes priority; B casts Artificial Evolution targeting token 1, tapping Island, and chooses to replace the creature type Soldier with Goblin.
Both players pass; Artificial Evolution resolves.
The board is read in main1 after resolution.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Token 1 is a 1/1 white Goblin creature named Soldier Token (its subtype is Goblin, not Soldier); token 2 is still a 1/1 white Soldier creature named Soldier Token.

variants.label: absent_type
variants.delta: B chooses to replace the creature type Elf with Goblin instead of Soldier with Goblin.
variants.expected: Token 1 and token 2 are both still 1/1 white Soldier creatures named Soldier Token; neither is a Goblin.

scenarios.forge_notes: B acts on A's turn with priority after Raise the Alarm resolves.

scenarios.title: Exchanging text boxes swaps the rules text of two creatures for as long as the enchantment remains

setup.notes: Serra Angel has flying and vigilance in its text box; Grizzly Bears has an empty text box.

decisions: A casts Exchange of Words, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; Exchange of Words resolves and enters the battlefield.
Its enters trigger goes on the stack targeting Serra Angel and Grizzly Bears; both players pass and it resolves.
The board is read in main1 after resolution.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is a 2/2 with flying and vigilance; Serra Angel is a 4/4 with no abilities. Power and toughness are unchanged on both. Exchange of Words is on the battlefield.

variants.label: enchantment_removed
variants.delta: After the trigger resolves, B casts Disenchant targeting Exchange of Words, tapping both Plains, and it resolves.
variants.expected: Exchange of Words is in A's graveyard; Serra Angel is a 4/4 with flying and vigilance again and Grizzly Bears is a 2/2 with no abilities.

scenarios.forge_notes: Implemented by ExchangeTextBox (TextBoxExchangeEffect) with Duration$ AsLongAsInPlay.

scenarios.title: An object with the full text of another object takes its name, mana cost, colors, types, abilities and power/toughness

setup.notes: Graveyard lists are bottom first, so the last entry is the top card. Base: Serra Angel is on top of A's graveyard.

decisions: No spell is cast and no ability is activated.
The board is read in main1.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Volrath's Shapeshifter is named Serra Angel with mana cost {3}{W}{W}, is a white 4/4 Angel creature with flying, vigilance and '{2}: Discard a card.'

variants.label: noncreature_on_top
variants.delta: The graveyard order is reversed, so Shock is the top card and Serra Angel is under it.
variants.expected: Volrath's Shapeshifter keeps its own characteristics: named Volrath's Shapeshifter, mana cost {1}{U}{U}, a blue 0/1 Phyrexian Shapeshifter creature with only '{2}: Discard a card.'

scenarios.forge_notes: Implemented as GainTextOf$ TopOfGraveyard.Creature in a static ability.

scenarios.title: An object with all names of nonlegendary creature cards has each of those names in addition to its own

setup.notes: Spy Kit is attached to A's Hill Giant (not B's). Echoing Truth returns the target and every other permanent with the same name as the target.

decisions: A casts Echoing Truth targeting B's Grizzly Bears, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Echoing Truth resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: B's Grizzly Bears returns to B's hand and A's equipped Hill Giant returns to A's hand; Spy Kit stays on the battlefield unattached; B's Hill Giant stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: unattached
variants.delta: Spy Kit is on A's battlefield but not attached to any creature.
variants.expected: Only B's Grizzly Bears returns to B's hand; A's Hill Giant and B's Hill Giant stay on the battlefield.

variants.label: own_name
variants.delta: Echoing Truth targets B's Hill Giant instead of B's Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: B's Hill Giant returns to B's hand and A's equipped Hill Giant returns to A's hand, since it keeps its own name; B's Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Check that sharesNameWith in Echoing Truth's ChangeZoneAll honors names added by AddNames$ AllNonLegendaryCreatureNames.

scenarios.title: An effect that sets an object's name replaces its previous names

setup.notes: B's two Grizzly Bears are called Bears 1 and Bears 2.

decisions: A casts Honest Work targeting Bears 1, tapping one Island.
Both players pass; Honest Work resolves, its enters trigger taps Bears 1, and the trigger resolves. Bears 1 is now a 1/1 Citizen named Humble Merchant.
A casts Echoing Truth targeting Bears 2, tapping two Islands.
Both players pass; Echoing Truth resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Bears 2 returns to B's hand; Bears 1, named Humble Merchant, stays on the battlefield enchanted by Honest Work.

variants.label: no_aura
variants.delta: A does not cast Honest Work; Bears 1 keeps the name Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Both Bears 1 and Bears 2 return to B's hand.

variants.label: target_renamed
variants.delta: Echoing Truth targets Bears 1 (named Humble Merchant) instead of Bears 2.
variants.expected: Only Bears 1 returns to B's hand; Honest Work goes to A's graveyard as a state-based action; Bears 2 stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Honest Work uses SetName$ Humble Merchant in its static ability.

scenarios.title: A spliced card's rules text is added to the spell and its effects also happen

setup.notes: Both cards are Arcane instants with splice onto Arcane {1}{R}.

decisions: A casts Desperate Ritual, revealing Glacial Ray from hand and paying its splice cost, choosing B as the target of Glacial Ray's 2 damage, and taps all four Mountains for {1}{R} plus {1}{R}.
Both players pass; Desperate Ritual resolves.
The state is read in main1 right after resolution.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: B is at 18 life; A has {R}{R}{R} in mana pool; Desperate Ritual is in A's graveyard and Glacial Ray is still in A's hand.

variants.label: no_splice
variants.delta: A does not splice Glacial Ray and pays only {1}{R} (two Mountains).
variants.expected: B is at 20 life; A has {R}{R}{R} in mana pool; Desperate Ritual is in A's graveyard and Glacial Ray is still in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Mana in the pool empties at the end of the step, so it is read in main1 straight after resolution.
